name: kxinsurrection
title: Will Trump invoke the Insurrection Act?
settlement: If the President of the United States has invoked the Insurrection Act to deploy the United States military and/or the federalized National Guard within the United States before the stated date, the market resolves to Yes. Nested markets cover before Dec 1, 2026, Jan 1, 2027, Jan 1, 2028 and Jan 20, 2029.
decideContext: Estimate how this news item changes the probability that the President formally invokes the Insurrection Act to deploy troops or federalized Guard domestically before the market's deadline. The market resolves Yes on formal invocation, not on threats or other deployment authorities.
